launcher.title: Provider readiness
launcher.description: Check which providers are ready before starting a new conversation.
launcher.error: Could not refresh provider readiness right now.
detail.unknown: TeamCow could not fully verify {{provider}} yet. You can refresh without blocking the shell.
boundary.action-blocked: Provider-backed chat actions are blocked until this provider is ready.
boundary.action-needs-check: Provider-backed chat actions need another readiness check before starting.
boundary.local-capabilities: Local project, history, files, diff, git, terminal, and editor handoff remain available.
boundary.provider-required: Starting or continuing chat requires a ready provider.
readiness.binary-not-found: {{provider}} CLI binary not found at expected path.
readiness.version-check-failed: {{provider}} CLI was found, but its version check failed: {{detail}}.
readiness.capability-missing: {{provider}} is installed, but this version does not provide the required {{capability}} capability.
repair.binary-not-found: Install {{provider}} CLI and make sure it is available on your PATH.
repair.version-check-failed: Run {{command}} --version in your login shell and fix the reported runtime or configuration error, then refresh readiness.
repair.capability-missing: Upgrade {{provider}} to a release that supports {{capability}}, then refresh readiness.
repair.auth-missing: Sign in to {{provider}} and refresh readiness.
repair.network-unreachable: Check your network connection and confirm the {{provider}} service endpoint is reachable.
repair.config-invalid: Fix the {{provider}} configuration and refresh readiness.
